free_text: A repeat biopsy is indicated due to the PI-RADS 4 finding in the right peripheral zone, which is a decisive factor in the cohort criterion. This is supported by the clinical suspicion derived from the PI-RADS 4 score and the PSA velocity of 1.32 ng/mL/yr. The evidence converged on a biopsy recommendation, driven by the identical precedent in the labelled series, despite unresolved questions regarding specific EAU thresholds.
